title: Fully Coupled Nonlinear Forward-Backward Stochastic Difference Equations: Spectral Contraction and Infinite-Horizon Maximum Principle
summary: This paper develops an explicit spectral-contraction approach to studying fully coupled nonlinear forward--backward stochastic difference equations on infinite horizon and their applications to stochastic control. The estimates for this fully coupled system are assembled into an explicit two-dimensional nonnegative matrix. Its spectral radius yields an explicit sufficient discount threshold, and a corresponding equivalent weighted product norm is constructed to establish the contraction property.
